homepageTopArticles.title: Ecommerce firms sell goods worth Rs 24,000 crore in first two days of festive sales: Redseer
homepageTopArticles.snippet: Players like Amazon and Flipkart are using their quick commerce arms for sales and increasing their salience on the platform, which saw 4 to 5 times higher GMV than the BAU daily average.
homepageTopArticles.aiSummary: Ecommerce firms including Amazon and Flipkart sold Rs 24,000 crore of goods in the first two days of festive sales, 4 to 5 times daily average.

homepageTopArticles.title: IKEA launches UK and Ireland marketplace to buy and sell second-hand furniture
homepageTopArticles.snippet:
Swedish brand IKEA has created an online marketplace for pre-owned furniture and products, which retail at around 60 per cent less than comparable items bought new. homepageTopArticles.title: Plumb Club Podcast Offers Jewelers Strategies for Managing Tariffs
homepageTopArticles.snippet: A new podcast from the Plumb Club examines how rapidly changing tariffs are affecting jewelry supply chains and offers practical steps retailers can take to protect their margins. Hosted by Cheryl Kremkow, the episode features Sara Yood, president, CEO, and general counsel of the Jewelers Vigilance Committee, and Steven Lerche, president of the Plumb Club…
homepageTopArticles.aiSummary: The Plumb Club launched a podcast episode with Sara Yood and Steven Lerche outlining strategies for jewelers to manage supply chain tariffs and protect margins.
